milestones.label: Real assignment/exercise event handling
milestones.note: 2026-07-15: added getOptionActivities to OptionsBroker (Alpaca's activities feed — OPASN=assigned/exercised, OPEXP=expired worthless), verified live against the real account (real historical OPEXP records came back correctly parsed). Built settle-live.ts (syncLiveSettlements): checks ALL open live positions (broker_order_id set), not just expired ones, so early assignment is caught — a spot-at-expiry comparison structurally can't do that. When a position is gone from the broker's open positions, looks up the matching activity to get the REAL outcome (not a guess) and settles using the same P&L formulas as strategy.ts's settle() (credit/fees/capitalGain — intentionally not calling settle() itself, to avoid coupling a well-tested pure function to broker-activity parsing; the ~6 lines of duplicated math are kept in lockstep and commented as such). Unmatched cases (gone from broker, no activity found) are surfaced as 'unresolved' rather than guessed. Wired into engine.ts as STEP 0 (runs before the existing simulated STEP 1, which now excludes broker_order_id-tagged rows via isNull so live and simulated settlement paths never double-touch the same position). Fixed a test-infra gap found while wiring: engine.test.ts's hand-rolled drizzle-orm mock didn't export isNull/isNotNull — added both. tsc/eslint clean, 124/124 tests pass (zero regression). Not exercised end-to-end (0 live positions exist to settle) — same caveat as every other milestone this session.

milestones.label: Kill-switch wired to cancel/flatten live orders
milestones.note: 2026-07-15: built kill-switch.ts (flattenLiveNow) — on kill_switch=true, cancels all resting broker orders then buy_to_close's every live-open DB position (broker_order_id set) at market. Idempotent by construction (only touches status='open' rows, flips to 'closed' once done, so repeated ticks while the switch stays on don't re-attempt already-closed positions — no separate lock needed). Wired into engine.ts's existing kill_switch guardrail, replacing the old halt-only behavior. Verified live: cancelAllOrders call succeeded against the real account (confirmed 0 open orders before/after — nothing there to cancel), DB query for live-open positions confirmed 0 rows (nothing to flatten). tsc/eslint clean, 124/124 tests pass including the existing kill_switch test (exact same outcomes:[] shape preserved when nothing to flatten). Design note: an unfilled close order is deliberately left resting rather than cancelled — cancelling would defeat the point of a flatten (silently leaves risk on); the next tick retries it instead.
